name: Ink Jade
tagline: Rice-paper ink-wash ground with vermilion seal stamps, vertical title, brush stroke and fine hairline frame (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Rice paper, black ink, vermilion seal red and faint gold

typography.style: Delicate high-contrast serif, stacked vertical title, tracked Inter micro labels

best_for: Fits cultural, craft and hospitality stories that want stillness and a literary mood. Sparse text with one red accent per slide works best.
avoid_for: Avoid for dense data, tech or bright consumer topics.
